How to use Uplink IT Academy

Anyone moving from help desk toward network engineering: students preparing CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Linux+ or Cisco CCNA, technicians who want a safe place to practise tickets and labs, and career changers who need a plan.

Open Uplink IT Academy →Read the bookContact

WalkthroughMotion design, real screens

It plays by itself. Tap a dot or the arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01Get started

Five steps, five minutes.

1

Open academy.lemonshops.app. Every room has free samples, so you can try before you sign in.

2

Create an account with your email to keep your progress, your XP and your streak.

3

Pick your exam on the Exams page and try the five free questions of any set.

4

Open the Ticket Simulator and take one ticket from the queue; it is the fastest way to feel what the platform does.

5

When a set or a tool is useful to you, buy only that set or that add-on; nothing else is required.

02Room by room

What is inside, and how to use it.

01Exams

Exams

Practice sets of two hundred original scenario questions per exam, dealt at random, each with a full explanation and a link to learn more. Five questions are free in every set.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Choose the vendor and the exam, then the set
  2. Answer, then read the explanation even when you were right
  3. Flag a question to review it later
  4. Use the AI analysis add-on to see your weak domains
02Ticket Simulator

Ticket Simulator

A service desk for a fictional company, Harborline Logistics. Tickets wait in a queue. You investigate with real tools: directory, server room, remote desktop, mail admin, asset management, documentation.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Open the queue and take a ticket assigned to you
  2. Read the symptoms, then open the Tools menu to investigate
  3. Take actions in order and write your resolution
  4. Submit; the simulator grades the steps and the fix
03Network Lab

Network Lab

Consoles for Windows, Linux, security analysis and Cisco devices. Each lab has a brief, a device, objectives and checks that turn green as you type the right commands.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Pick a track: A+, Network+, Security+, Linux+, CCNA, Meraki or UniFi
  2. Read the brief and the objectives
  3. Type commands at the prompt; type help if you are stuck
  4. Watch the checks and the board update, then read the concept note
04Troubleshoot

Troubleshoot

A coach that walks a case with you step by step: what to check first, what the result means, what to try next.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Start a case
  2. Answer the coach's questions with what you would actually do
  3. Read the feedback after each step
  4. Finish the case and review the method
05Courses and Career Agent

Courses and Career Agent

Short courses that explain the concepts behind the questions, and a career agent that reads a resume and plans the path from help desk to network engineer.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Follow a course lesson by lesson
  2. Paste a resume into the Career Agent
  3. Read the plan and the next three moves
  4. Come back weekly to update it
06Network Docs

Network Docs

For businesses: order drawn documentation of a real network. Fill the questionnaire, pay, and receive a documentation pack with diagrams and a PDF.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Open Network Docs and start a brief
  2. Answer the questionnaire about the site
  3. Pay for the tier you need
  4. Receive the pack by email and review it
03Tips
  • Study on your phone: every room is built for a small screen.
  • Read the explanation of every question; the explanation is the lesson.
  • Do one ticket a day; that habit is worth more than a hundred questions.
  • Keep your streak; XP and ranks are there to keep you coming back.
04FAQ
Do I need to pay to try it?

No. Five questions per set, sample tickets and sample labs are free.

Which exams are covered?

CompTIA A+ Core 1 and Core 2, Network+, Security+, Linux+, and Cisco CCNA. Others are listed as coming next.

Can I use it on a phone?

Yes, it is mobile first.

How do I get help?

Use the contact form on the academy, or write to hello@lemonshops.app.
